## Experience

- Data Analyst (volunteer), Erasmus Student Network, remote, May 2025 to Apr 2026. Replaced a manual monthly reporting process with three Looker Studio dashboards covering about 5,000 to 6,000 activities a month, available to 519 local sections in 45 countries. Cleaned and consolidated multi-source data. Documented dashboard logic and data definitions for handover.
- Junior Officer, Cards Data and Reporting, Eastern Bank PLC, Dhaka, Jul 2023 to Aug 2024. Analysed transaction and revenue data across about 25,000 corporate and co-brand card accounts (150,000+ transactions a month) with SQL. Found where co-brand usage was concentrated by region and flagged those regions for acquisition; active co-brand users grew 12% over the period. Built monthly revenue and portfolio reporting in Excel (Power Query, PivotTables) on SQL extracts for senior management. Data and product point of contact for 120+ branches.
- Executive, Procurement and Reporting, Tech Valley Networks Ltd., Mar 2022 to Jun 2023.
- Junior Officer, FZ Technologies Ltd., Feb 2021 to Feb 2022. Survey data quality and weekly stakeholder reporting.
- IT Intern, Shimanto Bank PLC, Sep 2020 to Dec 2020.

## Skills and evidence

- Used at work: SQL; Excel (Power Query, PivotTables); Looker Studio; data cleaning and consolidation; reporting to management and stakeholders.
- Study and projects: Python (pandas, NumPy) and R from coursework; statistics; multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA); sensitivity and uncertainty analysis; stakeholder elicitation.

## Projects

- [Online retail sales: SQL, Python and a KPI dashboard](https://gazish.github.io/projects/online-retail-analytics/): end-to-end analysis of the public UCI Online Retail II dataset (1,067,371 invoice lines, real data). SQL in DuckDB, KPI definitions, cohort retention, RFM segments, a revenue bridge, pandas cross-checks and an interactive dashboard. Code: https://github.com/gazish/gazish.github.io/tree/main/projects/online-retail-analytics
- [Card portfolio analysis and monthly reporting at Eastern Bank](https://gazish.github.io/projects/eastern-bank-card-reporting/): work case study (SQL, Excel).
- [Looker Studio dashboards at Erasmus Student Network](https://gazish.github.io/projects/esn-looker-studio-dashboards/): work case study (Looker Studio).
- [MSc thesis: Multi-Criteria Threat Evaluation for Local Climate Hazards](https://gazish.github.io/projects/thesis-climate-hazard-mcda/): a reusable MCDA decision-support template for municipalities, with weighted criteria, rubric-based scoring, survey-elicited stakeholder priorities, uncertainty ratings and best- and worst-case rank intervals, demonstrated on Tampere, Tartu and Malmö.
- [Decision analysis tool](https://gazish.github.io/projects/decision-analysis-tool/): browser-based MCDA tool built for this site, with weighted sum, AHP pairwise comparison with consistency ratio, weight stability intervals and Monte Carlo rank acceptability. Uses illustrative, made-up example data.
